description: Using a My device invitation has two surfaces with different labels and rules: 'Link this device' (My device invitation / Link device) exists only before identity confirmation, and afterwards the same invitation goes through 'Join a project' (Invitation / Join project), whose hint ('You keep your own identity; nobody else can create it for you.') doesn't describe device linking.
expected: One 'Use an invitation' form that detects the purpose and adapts its copy (e.g. 'This links this computer to Infra On-call as you').
actual: No 'Link this device' on Start or join; she must guess that Join a project accepts a My device invitation.
suggested_fix: Merge the two forms; after decoding the purpose, show purpose-specific confirmation copy.

description: While the inviter's My device dialog stays open, a used invitation keeps showing 'Waiting to be used' with Copy invite, Show invite text and Revoke; it only shows 'Used' after closing and reopening.
expected: The dialog refreshes (poll or on focus) and shows 'Used by priya-air' with the actions removed.
actual: Stale 'Waiting to be used · Expires in 24 h' with live action buttons.
suggested_fix: Poll the invitation list while the dialog is open (or refresh on window focus).

description: Right after the join, the project switcher says 'Infra On-call · Saved locally · waiting for hub' while the header SaveStatus for the same project says 'Saved locally · synced'.
expected: Both surfaces show the same current state.
suggested_fix: Refresh session.projects after join completes, or feed the switcher from the same live status as the header.
